summary:
Detailed implementation plan and architectural verification for TaskFlow:
- Multi-Device Real-time Cloud Sync & Account Provisioning via Firestore
- Role-Specific Isolated Deliverables & Admin Company History
- Task Completion Notes & Timestamp Modal
- Audible Reminder Alerts (Pop-up sound & notifications)
- Operational Activities & Compliance Audits Tabs with concrete examples
- Workgroup Creation (1-2 Managers, Multiple Staff) with Interactive Group Chat
- Non-overlapping Dual Floating Action Buttons (+ Team on left, + Task on right)
- Bottom Navigation AI Chatbot Tab
- Manager D3.js Priority Donut Chart & Bottleneck Distribution
